messages:
sasha: quick heads-up — i pushed a draft recruiting plan for a small ‘concierge micro-beta’ for DP/beta that focuses on high-latency, on-prem, and edge-ops customers. want to align on acceptance criteria & feedback loop before i share the invite template. TL;DR: recruit 8 partners, 4 on Dedicated/Private, 4 Hosted playbooks, 6-week engagement window.

michael: reading now. quick question — are we targeting feature validation (routing/fallback) or performance/ops? or both?

sasha: both, but phased. phase 1 = validate routing policies + fallback behavior with traffic shaping (2 weeks). phase 2 = perf/observability + cost metrics (4 weeks).

ana: i skimmed. suggest explicit success metric for signal quality — e.g., <5% false-positive fallback triggers and NPS >= 7 for onboarding.

ravi: for engineering, we need to lock a hardened rollback path. also we should limit model variants exposed for the beta to 2 (primary + fallback) to reduce surface area.

emily: from CS perspective, recruiting should prioritize customers who already have an SSO + existing infra integrations so we don’t spend onboarding cycles on infra plumbing. also they should sign up for weekly 30-min feedback slots.

ben: ops note — need to reserve Dedicated pool capacity for the 4 customers, mark as "concierge-beta" in the autoscaler. i'll schedule capacity hold once we confirm dates.

sasha: cool. can we capture acceptance criteria in one place? i put a quick checklist below — open to edits.

```
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (concierge micro-beta)
- 8 partners enrolled and active within first 3 weeks
- Onboarding docs completed by partner + first successful inference call within 48h of account activation
- Traceable routing/fallback incidents logged and reproduced in our staging runbook at least 3 times
- Observability: token-level latency and per-route error budget visible in console for each partner
- Quality guardrails: no regression in prompt-level quality (paired evals) > 90% pass on key prompts
- Operational SLA: mean request latency within agreed SLO (per partner) or automatic downgrade to hosted fallback
- Feedback cadence: weekly sync + weekly short survey; consolidated NPS >= 6 across partners
```

michael: nit — change "8 partners enrolled and active within first 3 weeks" to "8 partners committed; 6 active" to be realistic about dropouts.

sasha: good call. updating.

ana: i added a UX intake form for partner setup — fields include primary use-case, perf expectations, internal contact, sample prompts, and critical failure scenarios. i'll link the doc in a follow-up.

emily: one recruitment tip — prioritize partners who previously asked for private deployment or routing controls; list is: AcmeHealth, StreamEdge, DataForge, PixelApps, ClearBank, OrionOps, UnitLabs, HarborAI. do we want to ping them first?

ravi: AcmeHealth & StreamEdge would be great for routing tests. ClearBank is sensitive — needs legal ok for private.

ben: ops timeline — if we start onboarding Apr 6, we need reserved capacity by Apr 1. operator rota TBD.

sasha: proposal: recruitment outbound this week, onboarding kickoff Apr 6, phase1 routing Apr 8–21, phase2 perf Apr 22–May 31. owners: michael (partner comms), ana (UX intake + evals), emily (CS recruitment & weekly sync), ravi (runtime runbook + rollback), ben (capacity).

michael: i can draft the partner invite + acceptance contract. will include opt-in metrics and data handling checklist.

ana: for feedback loop, let's do short paired evals every 2 weeks and a 5-question micro-survey after each sync. i’ll create a tiny rubric.

sasha: can everyone add 1 blocker by EOD today? i’ll consolidate and send the invite draft tomorrow morning.

ravi: blocker — need a test harness for simulated region failover to exercise fallback. ETA: 2 weeks if prioritized.

emily: blocker — internal legal review for ClearBank might take 3+ weeks. we should mark them as standby.

ben: blocker — GPU quota in cluster may require a ticket to cloud partner; file submitted today but uncertain lead time.

sasha: noted. i'll reorder the invite list to push ClearBank to standby and prioritize AcmeHealth/StreamEdge. michael — want to own partner comms + timeline?

michael: yep, i'll own comms. will send first outreach Fri (tomorrow) with calendar options for Apr 6 kickoff.

ana: sending intake form link in 30m.

emily: i'll warm up the CS playbook and create the weekly 30-min feedback slot template.

ravi: i'll start the simulated failover harness branch and post a short runbook snippet in the thread when ready.

ben: will confirm capacity hold once we have signoffs.

sasha: perfect — check-in quick call Mon 9am if everyone can? (15m)

michael: +1

ana: +1 :thumbsup:

ravi: ok for me

emily: good for CS

(dp-bot): Reminder: new beta ticket #BETA-112 created for "concierge micro-beta" (assignee: michael).
